strings.zh: 奇怪？听不大清楚⋯⋯{NEWLINE}难道是电话⋯⋯坏了吗？{SCROLL}你换个地方再打过来吧！
strings.en: Huh? I can’t hear you. I think we’ve{NEWLINE}got a bad connection.{SCROLL}Go somewhere else and call again!

strings.zh: 喂喂⋯⋯{NEWLINE}你最近怎么样？{CLEAR}我身体可好得很！{SCROLL}
我的弟弟妹妹都说{NEWLINE}非常感谢你陪他们玩,{CLEAR}看来你在小孩子中很有人气哦。
strings.en: My little brothers and sisters say{NEWLINE}thanks a lot for playing with them.{CLEAR}Looks like you’re a real hit with kids.

strings.en: Hey, you called at just the right time!{NEWLINE}I’m free right now.{CLEAR}Want to battle me again? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 很好！{NEWLINE}我很期待这场对战！{SCROLL}那我先到战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋去等你了！{CLEAR}不是尼比市的道馆,{CLEAR}不要搞错了！
strings.en: All right! I’m looking{NEWLINE}forward to this battle!{SCROLL}I’ll head over to the Trainer{NEWLINE}House at the Battle Frontier{CLEAR}and wait for you there!{SCROLL}Not the Pewter Gym, so{NEWLINE}don’t get confused!

strings.zh: 是吗⋯⋯{NEWLINE}看来你也有{CLEAR}很多事要忙啊。

strings.zh: 嗯⋯⋯虽然我也很想{NEWLINE}和你战斗⋯⋯{CLEAR}可你不是有其他{CLEAR}对战的预约吗？{SCROLL}等你解决完其他的{NEWLINE}训练师的预约后{CLEAR}再给我打电话吧！
strings.en: Yeah, I’d really like to battle with you{NEWLINE}again... But I think you’ve got an{CLEAR}appointment with someone else?{SCROLL}Once you’ve taken care of your{NEWLINE}obligations with other Trainers,{CLEAR}then call me again!

strings.zh: 我在战斗前线的训练家屋{NEWLINE}等你！{CLEAR}这是我们训练师之间的约定！

strings.zh: 我是小刚,{NEWLINE}你最近还好吧？{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我们不是约好了在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋对战的吗？{CLEAR}你不会忘了吧？
strings.en: We agreed to battle at the Trainer{NEWLINE}House at the Battle Frontier, didn’t{CLEAR}we? You didn’t forget, did you?

strings.zh: 最近发生了一场{NEWLINE}很大的地震。{CLEAR}我们道馆墙壁{CLEAR}都有点损坏了。{SCROLL}不过,{NEWLINE}我们道馆{SCROLL}就算墙壁有一点点损坏{NEWLINE}也没人会注意到的！
strings.en: There was a big earthquake recently.{NEWLINE}The walls of my Gym got a little{CLEAR}damaged. But hey, even if our Gym’s{CLEAR}walls are a bit damaged, nobody would{CLEAR}ever notice!

strings.zh: 这个世界上{NEWLINE}有很多类型的精灵。{CLEAR}但我还是{CLEAR}最喜欢岩石系精灵。{SCROLL}又硬又狂野,{NEWLINE}虽然长相上{CLEAR}有点吓人,{CLEAR}但只要你接触一下,就会{CLEAR}感叹怎么会有这么可爱的东西。{SCROLL}你也是这么认为的吧？
strings.en: There are so many types of{NEWLINE}Pokémon in the world, but I still{CLEAR}like Rock-type Pokémon best.{SCROLL}They’re tough and wild, and they{NEWLINE}can look a little scary, but once{CLEAR}you get to know them, you’ll wonder{CLEAR}how anything could be so cute.{SCROLL}You think so too, right?

strings.zh: 每个精灵道馆在各个城市里的{NEWLINE}造型和设施都不一样,{CLEAR}是不是很有意思啊！{SCROLL}那是因为从精灵联盟{NEWLINE}来的道馆馆主{CLEAR}对其进行了自由的改造。{SCROLL}当然,尼比市道馆{NEWLINE}也是我的得意之作！{SCROLL}虽然我这儿的设施不是很好,{NEWLINE}但你走进来后,{CLEAR}是不是感到很震撼啊？
strings.en: Every town’s Pokémon Gym is different!{NEWLINE}The design, the tricks, everything is so{CLEAR}different. It’s interesting!{SCROLL}Each Gym Leader assigned to take care{NEWLINE}of a Gym by the Pokémon League gets to{CLEAR}design as they please.{SCROLL}Of course, Pewter Gym’s design is my{NEWLINE}pride and joy!{SCROLL}The tricks aren’t much, but you can’t{NEWLINE}deny that when you enter, the design{CLEAR}has a breathtaking impact, right?
